newsitem.title: USA: Apple fuels tech rally, ups Nasdaq to sixth record.
newsitem.headline: Apple fuels tech rally, ups Nasdaq to sixth record.

text.p: A 33-percent surge in Apple Computer Inc led the technology sector's continued rally on Wednesday, pushing the Nasdaq to its sixth consecutive record close.

The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 8.80 points or 0.54 percent to close unofficially at 1630.42, the thirty-third record closing high since January. Advancing issues beat losers 2479 to 1897 on total volume of about 766 million shares.

Apple jumped 6-9/16 to 26-5/16 after Microsoft Corp said it would invest $150 million in the struggling computer maker and develop more programs for the Macintosh. Apple's gains further fueled the recent rally in technology stocks, traders said.

"The techs looked OK anyway, but with Apple, it's like pouring gasoline on a fire, it just gets hotter," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of over-the-counter trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.
While most bellwether technology stocks showed gains, Cisco Systems Inc slipped after its fourth-quarter earnings failed to meet Wall Street's most optimistic estimates.
